title: Lion's Hiccup Sounds
lesson: Staying calm and laughing when something silly happens, and helping a friend
summary: Lion gets the hiccups and every hic comes out as a different animal sound, until his friends find a surprise cure.

steps.say: Roar! Big Lion is walking in the forest. Then, hic!

steps.text: Hic! Oh my! What was that?

steps.say: Out popped a tiny meow! Lion did not say roar at all.

steps.text: Hic! Meow! I am a lion, not a cat!

steps.say: Along came Duck, waddle, waddle.

steps.text: Quack! Lion, did you just meow?
Hic! Meow! I have the hiccups. Please help me!
Quack! Let us find a cure. Come with me!

steps.say: Duck led Lion to the pond. Splish, splash!

steps.text: Quack! A sip of cool water stops hiccups.

steps.say: Lion took a big sip. Gulp, gulp, gulp.

steps.text: Hic! QUACK! Oh no. Now I quack!
Quack, quack! Two quacks. Now we sound the same!

steps.say: Duck giggled. Lion giggled too. Hic, hic, ha, ha!

steps.text: Water did not work. Let us ask Pig.

steps.say: In the garden, Pig was picking orange carrots.

steps.text: Oink! Hello, friends! Why do you sound so silly?
Hic! Oink! I have the hiccups, Pig.
Oink, oink! Easy! Hold your breath and count to five.

steps.say: Lion held his breath. Can you count with us?
One!
Two!
Three!

steps.text: Hic! Moo! Oh dear, I mooed!

steps.say: The count started again. Hiccups are very tricky!

steps.text: Oink! Maybe you need a big surprise.

steps.say: The three friends went to the beach. Whoosh, went the waves.

steps.text: Quack! Pig, what surprise can we make?
Oink! Let us hide, and jump out together!

steps.say: Lion walked along the sand. His tummy went hic! every few steps.

steps.text: Hic! Baa! Now I sound like a sheep!
Hic! Hee-haw! Hic! Cluck! So many sounds!

steps.say: Can you make a sheep sound with us? Baa!
Duck and Pig hid behind the striped umbrella.
Lion looked all around. Where did his friends go?

steps.text: Hic! Quack? Oink? Where are you?
Surprise! Quack!
Surprise! Oink!

steps.say: Lion jumped so high! His heart went boom!

steps.text: Roar! You gave me a fright!

steps.say: Everyone was quiet. Then Lion opened his mouth. Would he meow?

steps.text: Roar! A real roar! The hiccups are gone!
Quack! Hooray! The surprise worked!
Oink! Lion, you made so many sounds today!

steps.say: Lion roared. Duck quacked. Pig oinked. Can you do all three?

steps.text: Thank you, friends. You helped me so much.

steps.say: The end!
